texts.label: Number passages, cc. 3v-23r
texts.summary: Estate and grain business from a convent in Naples: the sequestration of San Paolo by Don Paolo Ruffo, and a request for licensed grain that she turned aside because the Camera held the licences for the State of Milan.
texts.note: Number words 198: as sense 172 (86.9%), no restored or changed letter 172 (86.9%), 17 doubtful, 9 not read.

reading_review.by: AI language-model agent (for WAINUT; a model reading, not a person), independent of the solver
reading_review.note: Read as sentences 3 Nov 2026. Most passages read as Italian sentences and match the English: the San Paolo sequestration by Paolo Ruffo, 'Per amor di Dio... fidarci di nessuno', c. 20r on the loading, and above all c. 21r on the Torre Maggiore grain licences held by the Camera for Milan. About a third of the sentences have holes, and they are clustered rather than scattered: c. 3v has several weak guesses (stcmo/sperate, seculnorio->sequestratore, spaltta->Spagna, banatte unread, 'Mog.' wives line muddled), c. 4r opens with 'lutti pollici nelli' and 'uocire' unread, c. 11r is a fragment that does not make sense, c. 22r and the last line of c. 23r ('preceti') are unclear, and two code groups ([109], [182]) are unidentified.
